description: This PHP source file defines a controller class `Language` within the Opencart admin module. It manages language list data for all stores, providing methods to generate language data files, list languages for a specific store, and clear generated language files.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language list data across stores, including generating, listing, and clearing language JSON files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates language list tasks for all stores by creating tasks with specific arguments.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves stored language data for a specific store, generates a JSON file with this data, and handles directory and file creation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated language JSON files for all stores and languages.
